decisions.reason: The reusable citrus harvesting crate is a narrow agriculture-specific item with only limited website visibility and weak fit with the firm's broader multi-industry packaging portfolio.
The foldable large container is a core reusable logistics product with broad cross-sector demand and it had the strongest sustained website support, indicating good strategic value.
A stackable plastic crate fits the firm's standard reusable packaging range well and should remain useful across food, retail and industrial customers even without heavy standalone promotion.
A medium-duty rackable pallet sits close to the firm's core pallet business and supports customers seeking durable reusable transport solutions at scale.
The spill-retention pallet appears to be a more specialized niche product whose reduced prominence suggests limited momentum compared with the firm's main reusable transport lines.
The plastic pallet with load retainers adds practical transport stability to a core pallet category and remains consistent with the firm's value proposition of lowering logistics inefficiency.
